variants.label: Iceland highlights · 7 nights
variants.notes: Two Reykjavík nights lead into the Golden Circle and a four-night Hella/Hvolsvöllur stay, followed by one easy airport night. A protected weather-flex day and optional Blue Lagoon finale keep the week resilient.

sourceLocators.icelandair-pit-kef-2027-fare: Icelandair plan-ahead table displayed a matching Jun 13–21, 2027 PIT–KEF fare signal on 2026-07-13

alternateNotes: Seven nights is already the short-trip ceiling; a shorter alternative would remove the weather buffer that makes the route resilient.
